posts.text: The Trump admin’s savage cuts—first in their so-called “big beautiful bill,” now the Medicaid tsunami hitting in January—are crashing into a growing maternal health crisis. Over 80% of these deaths are preventable. This is a moral obscenity and is an especially urgent moment for Black mothers. If we truly love our country, our children, and our families, this must be a unifying call. Mothers are dying every day. We can—and must—do better.

posts.text:
This is one of those sacred anniversaries: 61 years of the Voting Rights Act. We can't just remember this anniversary,  We must honor it by taking action to defend our rights, just like our ancestors did. 

When the Court tried to take our rights—Dred Scott, Plessy—we answered with our feet, our voices, our votes.  

 We cannot be silent. We cannot be still.  Organize. Mobilize. Democracy is not a spectator sport.
